static_traits.name: 陈思琪
static_traits.family_status: 父亲曾开出租车，叔叔在渔船上工作
static_traits.medical_history: without心理治疗史；without显著躯体疾病史；过去not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑较好、能配合与Reflection；倾向Self-denial与负面预测；语速与言语流畅度Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I have a persistent belief that if I go back on the local news, people will think I am dumb.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear of being negatively viewed and judged by others has begun to affect my decisions and potential opportunities, so I hope to deal with this cognitive distortion in counseling.
growth_experiences: 曾在当地新闻上出现一次，因紧张而口误、词not达意；事件后持续反复回想并担心他人会因此认为自己愚蠢，恐惧评判随着时间加重，导致在涉及公众曝光的机会前出现显著回避。

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough/会被认为愚蠢

special_situations.event: When the topic of appearing on local news again or appearing in public is raised
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show up again and make a small mistake, everyone will conclude I am stupid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids any opportunity to be on camera or speak publicly (refuses media interaction and public speaking)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会搞砸，所有人都会觉得我很笨

special_situations.event: 回想过去那次新闻采访中的紧张与口误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次表现not佳就说明我not适合公开场合/not够聪明
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或忽略任何正面因素，以此提醒自己not要再尝试公开露面
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那次表现not好就说明我not行

special_situations.event: Work opportunities requiring public speaking or media interaction arise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I appear in public, I will definitely be harshly criticized and mocked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Directly declining opportunities and choosing low-exposure roles to avoid evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会盯着我的错误not放

special_situations.event: 考虑是否向家人或朋友分享自己的担忧
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达恐惧，他们会认为我小题大做或not值得认真对待
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 保持沉默、not寻求支持以避免被轻视
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我在夸大其词

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与正向看见（在公众场合被理解且not被贬低）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被羞辱、被视为愚蠢并遭受负面评判
defense_goal: By avoiding public exposure and self-limiting, reduces the possibility of being judged and humiliated

object_relations.self_representation: 容易犯错、会被羞辱的脆弱者
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻评判、挑剔的他人/观众

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When opportunities requiring public exposure arise or being invited to give public speeches/media interactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will judge harshly and focus on my mistakes (projecting inner self-criticism outward)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以理性、客观的语气给出not参加的“充分理由”（如风险大、收益小），用大量“但是/因为”来证明回避的正当性。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师邀请进行证据检视或现实测试时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Uses 'logical / theoretical' discussion to keep distance from strong emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use“逻辑上”“理论上”等词，降低情感表达强度，以分析性的语气讨论担忧而not触及羞耻与恐惧。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当回忆过去在新闻中的口误与紧张片段时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的羞耻与自我贬损归因于他人会认为自己愚蠢（Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 频繁use“他们会……”“大家都会……”句式，强调外界负面看法；弱化自我感受的表达。

manifestations: 因害怕评判而回避公众活动与媒体曝光
拒绝需要公开发言的工作机会
在重要机会前被“最坏情境”思维所限制
not yet与亲友分享该恐惧，担心被认为夸大其词
在需要支持时保持沉默与回避
outcomes: 支持系统not yet被有效激活

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Describes external attitudes with 'they will think I am stupid', 'everyone will criticize me'
将内在自我贬损体验归因于他人看法

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 过度自责、认为自己会搞砸
在公Empathy境中过度谨慎并选择回避

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turning the impulse to express/try outward into self-suppression and avoidance
not向亲友寻求帮助，保持沉默

Having basic social support resources (a few relatives and friends to talk to)
Able to conduct logical examination and admit the lack of evidence for negative outcomes

灾难化、预测not yet来与读心术等认知歪曲维持Anxiety
习惯性回避公众场合导致恐惧被Reinforcement

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids public exposure (appearing on local news, public speeches, media interactions)
antecedent: 当讨论再次上当地新闻时
面对需要公开露面的机会时
回想过去采访中的紧张与口误时
target_behavior.core_reason: 源于那次新闻采访的负性记忆与对他人评判的恐惧，伴随灾难化、读心术与negate正面信息的自动化思维
target_behavior.function: Escaping shame and negative evaluation，降低即时Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 拒绝机会、Career development受限、减少参与活动并持续承受中度压力
